kawaguchiko.note: Do not store booking reference, PIN, payment card, or other sensitive reservation credentials in the repository.

strategy.travel_style: slow family resort trip; avoid shopping-heavy city days
strategy.night_1_2: Tokyo central/east, around Tsukiji / Higashi-Ginza / Shiodome
strategy.route: Haneda -> Tokyo two nights -> Tokyo rental pickup -> Kawaguchiko/Oshino Hakkai one night -> Tokyo rental return -> Asakusa/Skytree -> Narita
strategy.priority: Family vacation feeling, Mt. Fuji scenery, minimal shopping, and one simple Tokyo-based rental-car segment
strategy.car_policy: Rent and return the car in Tokyo. Preferred pattern: pick up near Tokyo Station on 10/16 morning, drive to Kawaguchiko, stay one night, return to the same Tokyo-area branch on 10/17 around early afternoon, then continue to Asakusa by public transit or taxi.
strategy.tsukiji_policy: Use Day 2 morning for Tsukiji; do not rely on Sunday 10/18 for the full Tsukiji experience.

proposals.title: 松山 -> 羽田 13:10 -> 東京慢慢開始
items: CI220 松山 09:00 出發，羽田 T3 13:10 抵達
進東京後入住築地／東銀座／汐留一帶，先休息
傍晚只安排東銀座、銀座街景或濱離宮周邊低強度散步
銀座不排百貨巡禮，晚餐保持彈性

proposals.title: 築地早餐 -> 東京慢遊日
items: 約 09:00 到築地場外市場吃早餐／早午餐並慢慢逛
之後接濱離宮或東銀座，不跨城趕場
下午保留咖啡、散步與休息時間
若 Day 4 住宿確定在淺草／押上，可把大行李寄往 Day 4 飯店；10/16 只帶一晚行李

proposals.title: 東京取車 -> 河口湖：富士山度假日
proposals.overnight: 富士之宿溫泉旅館 大池飯店 (Oike Hotel)
items: 約 08:00 在東京站一帶取車；首選同店租還，避免異地還車費與規則差異
從東京自駕往河口湖，主路線走首都高速接中央自動車道；依早高峰與高速路況預留彈性
抵達富士山區後先看能見度：天氣好就優先停富士山景觀點
安排忍野八海
午餐簡單處理，不為名店排長隊
下午前往大石公園／河口湖北岸散步看富士山
15:00-18:00 之間入住大池飯店
入住後不再排遠距離景點，以飯店溫泉、晚餐與休息為主
proposals.planning_note: 若富士山完全露出，可把大石公園提早；富士山能見度優先於固定順序。

proposals.title: 河口湖慢早晨 -> 自駕回東京還車 -> 淺草 -> 晴空塔 -> TORIYOSHI
items: 07:00-09:00 起床看富士山、早餐、泡湯，不排遠程景點
10:00 前從大池飯店退房
若早晨天氣很好，可在湖畔短停 20-30 分鐘後再離開
自駕返回東京；週六進東京需為中央道與東京都內壅塞預留時間
目標約 12:30-14:00 在東京站一帶還車
還車後搭大眾運輸／計程車前往淺草／押上住宿並休息
下午雷門、仲見世、淺草寺、下町巷弄慢遊
晴空塔視家人體力與還車時間決定，必要時刪除
晚餐優先浅草 TORIYOSHI；訂位前再確認無牛需求
proposals.planning_note: Day 4 優先級：河口湖慢早晨 > 安全回東京還車 > 淺草 > TORIYOSHI > 晴空塔。

proposals.title: 淺草／押上慢早晨 -> 成田 T2 -> 桃園
items: 睡晚一點，在淺草／隅田川附近早餐與散步
若 Day 4 沒逛完淺草，上午補完即可
中午至下午保留自由時間與休息
約 16:00-16:30 從淺草／押上出發前往成田機場 T2
CI109 成田 T2 20:00 起飛，桃園 T2 22:45 抵達

fuji_segment_detail.recommendation: Tokyo pickup and Tokyo return, one continuous rental for the Fuji segment.

rental_car.preferred_shop: Toyota Rent a Car Tokyo Station Nihonbashi Exit as first candidate; Tokyo Station Yaesu is a backup
rental_car.return_policy: Prefer same-shop return unless another Tokyo branch offers a clearly better verified option.
rental_car.reason: Close to the likely first Tokyo hotel area, convenient after return for onward travel to Asakusa, and avoids needing a Fuji-area rental pickup/return.

route_order: Oishi Park / north shore of Lake Kawaguchi
next morning Oike Hotel Fuji view / optional lakeside stop
fuji_segment_detail.weather_rule: Mt. Fuji visibility overrides the order once in the Fuji area.

rental_car_option.scope: Tokyo pickup on 10/16 morning to Tokyo return on 10/17 early afternoon
why: Matches the user's preference to rent and return in Tokyo
No need to handle luggage on a highway bus
Keeps full flexibility around Kawaguchiko and Oshino Hakkai
Same-shop return is operationally simpler than one-way rental
verify_before_booking: actual 10/16-10/17 vehicle availability and total price
ETC card rental and expressway tolls
international driving permit / Japanese license-document requirements for the actual driver
Tokyo branch vehicle-height restrictions if choosing a larger family vehicle

food_preferences.yakitori: Current preferred restaurant is 浅草 TORIYOSHI. User prefers a casual chicken-focused yakitori meal and wants to avoid beef. Reconfirm no beef, beef fat or beef stock before booking if strict avoidance is required.
